definitions.explanation: More than expected when compared to something else.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割|わり}と⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割|わり}と⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{割|わり}と⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a movie I rather like.

examples.japanese: {割|わり}と⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{割|わり}と⟦{安|やす}かった→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: It was relatively cheaper than I thought.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割|わり}と⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{割|わり}と⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{割|わり}と⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{割|わり}と⟦{満足|まんぞく}している→満足する：02496_manzoku⟧。
{割|わり}と⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{割|わり}と is an adverb meaning "relatively" or "fairly," often implying something exceeded expectations.

FORMS:
- {割|わり}と (standard)
- ⟦{割|わり}に→割に：16763_warini⟧ (similar, but also used as particle meaning "considering")
- ⟦わりかし→わりかし：noentry⟧ (casual variation)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {割|わり}と⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ (relatively easy)
- {割|わり}と⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (rather like)
- {割|わり}と⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (fairly early)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {割|わり}と vs. ⟦{比較的|ひかくてき}→比較的：06172_hikakuteki⟧: ⟦{比較的|ひかくてき}→比較的：06172_hikakuteki⟧ is more formal and objective; {割|わり}と is more casual and subjective.
- {割|わり}と vs. ⟦けっこう→けっこう：10387_kekkou⟧: Both mean "fairly/rather," but ⟦けっこう→けっこう：10387_kekkou⟧ can also mean "quite a lot" or be stronger. They're often interchangeable.
- {割|わり}と vs. ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧: ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧ has a nuance of "surprisingly good" or "not easily."

Register: Casual to neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
